harness.name: omp (oh-my-pi coding agent)
harness.session: kept in the attempt's fresh home (no --no-session), so omp's artifact:// spill read-back works as shipped
harness.compaction: as shipped. Offline (scripted server): it fires once the reported context passes about 56,800 tokens (between 56,000 and 57,000); the handoff method sends a model request with the same system prompt and tools plus tool_choice none and the 4,096 cap; if that fails, a short-summary request with no tools, another system prompt and a cap of 512; shaking replaces old tool results with stubs. Compaction requests count toward the request cap.

proxy.gateway_header: the campaign transport's gateway_header, as MC-90 to MC-111 sent it

smoke.system_prompt_note: All four first requests carried the probe's system prompt hash; the task arrived byte for byte; only the eight probe keys were received; temperature 1.0 was sent; no reasoning text came back.
smoke.cap_check: smoke-4's last request stopped with finish_reason length at 4,096 completion tokens; the attempt mapped to answer_cap. The gateway honours omp's max_completion_tokens.
smoke.tool_calls: smoke-1 and smoke-2: two greps each, then the letter. smoke-3: a read of the folder (directory listing) and a read of one file, then 'Đáp án: B'. smoke-4: one glob and two failed reads, then the capped answer.
smoke.budget_basis: MC-112's DSHF used 25,703,365 tokens over its 268 attempts. The same smoke questions cost 1.79x (smoke-1: 12,854 vs 7,170) and 1.56x (smoke-2: 15,601 vs 9,988) in omp, mostly omp's larger system prompt and tool schemas re-sent on every request. Projection at the larger ratio: 25.7M x 1.79 = 46.1M; x 1.5 = 69.1M; rounded up: 70,000,000.
